_comment: Prox asked for 'a settings configurator that takes process + material + thickness
and outputs recommended wire speed and voltage'. There is no such table in any of
the three documents, and the reason is the interesting part: this is an Auto Weld
(synergic) machine. You enter wire/rod/electrode diameter and material thickness,
and the welder derives amperage and voltage itself. The manual says so outright on
page 20 -- 'the white mark on the line shows the recommended setting for your
So the honest configurator does not refuse and does not invent a wire-speed table.
It returns the procedure the machine actually uses, per process, verbatim, with the
page you can check it on. Everything below is a substring of its cited page.

synergic.claim: The machine derives wire feed speed and voltage from wire diameter and material thickness; the operator does not look them up.
synergic.quote: Note: If the Wire Feed Speed or Voltage settings are adjusted manually, the white mark on the line shows the recommended setting for your wire/electrode diameter and workpiece thickness.

approximateNote._comment: Decal only. The word 'approximate' appears ZERO times in all 48 pages of the owner's manual -- this caveat exists nowhere but the sticker inside the door, which is exactly why the decal had to be ingested as a source.
approximateNote.quote: Auto Weld Settings are approximate. Adjust settings as necessary.

processes.adjustStep: Turn Left Knob to adjust Wire Feed Speed (Amperage). Turn Right Knob to adjust Voltage.

onScreenExample._comment: The manual's own screenshot, reproduced on the door decal. The page interleaves two screens, so this is shown as an example of what the display looks like -- NOT asserted as the recommended pair for a particular job.

processes.quote: a. Polarity and Gas Settings: • Plug cables in according to screen. • Connect gas according to screen. • Set SCFH between 20-30. b. Set Wire Diameter and Material Thickness: • Turn Left Knob to set wire diameter. • Turn Right Knob to set material thickness.

decalScreens._comment: Transcribed from the door decal panel for this process. Image-only: these are what the LCD shows in the decal's illustration, not a recommendation for any particular job.

processes.adjustStep: Turn Left Knob to adjust output amperage. Turn Right Knob to ON to energize TIG Torch.
processes.quote: a. Polarity and Gas Settings: • Plug cables in according to screen. • Connect gas according to screen. • Set SCFH between 10-25. b. Set Rod Diameter and Material Thickness: • Turn Left Knob to set rod diameter. • Turn Right Knob to set material thickness.

processes.adjustStep: Turn Left Knob to adjust output amperage. Turn Right Knob to ON to energize Electrode Holder.
processes.quote: b. Set Electrode type: • Turn Main Control Knob to set electrode type. c. Set Electrode Diameter and Material Thickness: • Turn Left Knob to set electrode diameter. • Turn Right Knob to set material thickness.
